output.objection: I need the evaluation harness to trigger automatically the moment a new model version is ready. If I have to wait for a human to click a button, I cannot iterate on the weather features fast enough.
output.correction: You are treating this as a general reporting gap, but I am specifically asking for automated execution of the evaluation pipeline. The goal is to remove the manual trigger from the model deployment workflow entirely.
